description: Search GigXchange's OFFICIAL help articles — the platform's own documentation of how it works (payments, bookings, profiles, messages, account, what to do when something goes wrong). Use for any "how does GigXchange work / how do I ..." question. Returns matching articles with their url, or no results when the help centre does not cover a topic. Platform mechanics (fees, deposits, cancellation rules) are specific to GigXchange and differ from other marketplaces.
